title: S3 Spine — Operator Sequencing Rules
description: Canonical sequencing rules for force‑regime operators across S3 nodes, including semantic constraints, dimensional amplifiers, and rupture‑integrity safety conditions.

constraints.description: Gradient operators may precede field operators when gradientIntensity is stable or increasing.
Field operators may precede integrity operators when fieldCoherence supports structural stability.
High gradientIntensity may induce rupture; ruptureForce accelerates this transition.
Integrity may fail under ruptureForce; sequencing allowed only when rupturePotential exceeds threshold.

forbiddenSequences.reason: Rupture cannot directly produce gradient; violates causal direction of S3 spine.
Integrity cannot directly generate gradient; requires field or continuity mediation.
Rupture disrupts fieldCoherence; field cannot be reconstructed without gradient stabilization.

rules: FieldShift may redirect gradient flow but cannot exceed max intensity.
FieldCoherence must be nonzero to transition to integrity.
RupturePotential increases under push and ruptureForce.
Integrity sequencing requires rupturePotential below threshold.
Integrity increases under bind and pull.
Integrity decreases under push and ruptureForce.
Integrity must exceed threshold to suppress rupture.

push.description: Push amplifies gradient; may destabilize integrity.

pull.description: Pull stabilizes gradient and integrity; suppresses rupture.

bind.description: Bind increases coherence and integrity; cannot follow rupture.

gradient.description: Gradient modulation is universally compatible except after rupture.

fieldShift.description: FieldShift reorients fields; cannot operate after rupture.

ruptureForce.description: RuptureForce increases rupturePotential; incompatible with stabilization operators.
